scope: Cache/Health agents + List Agents endpoint + liveness probe + global error handler

feature_test_scripts.scripts_summary: Per-user namespacing 'agent_cache:{user_id}:{key}'; action Literal[get,set,delete]; key min/max 1/128; ttl 1-86400 capped at 24h; model_validator enforces value when action='set'; get hit boolean; delete hit=bool(removed); summary surfaces normalised key (without prefix)

3 components: postgres SELECT 1, redis PING, anthropic env var presence (no remote call); each catches Exception → ok=False; aggregated summary ok = AND of all; placeholder 'your-' prefix detected as not-set
GET /api/v1/agents returns {data:[...], total} via list_agents() helper from gateway; auth-gated
GET /health returns {status:'ok'}; no auth; 200 always; main.py:117

HTTPException with dict detail{error:...} pass-through; otherwise wraps in {detail}; unhandled Exception → 500 with {error:{code:'internal_error', details:{path, exception:str(exc)[:300]}}}; logs full traceback server-side
